scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan,magenta "pnpm dev:shared" "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/shared build && pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/backend build && pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/shared lint && pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/backend lint && pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/backend typecheck && pnpm --filter @modern-web-stack/frontend typecheck
